parameters: Player-prior and residual penalties selected exclusively by pre-cutoff game-group CV. No test-dependent coefficient or rating multiplier.
role: Pre-cutoff CV selects role prior; if role+offense significantly worsens either netRMSE or winMAE versus offense-only at main41, keep offense-only. Otherwise retain the training-selected role prior.
net: No extra player net residual injected without a demonstrated remaining training representation gap after attack/defense controls. Offline simultaneous defense coefficients exist for confound control, not automatic adoption.
neutral: One common switch across cutoffs. Adopt if at least one cutoff improves netRMSE or winMAE significantly and no cutoff significantly worsens either metric. Report calibration slope without a veto, per user. Paired20seed percentile bootstrap. Candidate selection is exploratory, not multiple-comparison-adjusted.
success: Both netRMSE and winMAE significantly improve versus v3 in at least2 of25/41/55 and main41 point estimates no worse than simple baseline; report uncertainty against deterministic simple forecasts separately.
